\begin{table}[htbp]
  \centering
  \caption{Reproducibility ceiling of each metabolically relevant target, from the
  source's own repeats. Reliability is the fraction of the variance in the stored value
  that is not measurement noise, and its square root is the highest Pearson correlation
  any predictor of the true level can reach against that stored value. Retest columns
  are the correlation between two measurements of the same strain; the betaxanthin
  release carries no such pair, so its reliability comes from the within-gene and
  between-gene variance split instead. The single-measurement column differs from the
  stored-value column only for betaxanthin, whose stored value averages many colonies.}
  \label{tab:target-reliability}

    Amino acids (19) & 194 & 0.43 & 0.20 & 0.42 & 0.62 \\
    Isobutanol biosensor & 190 & 0.11 & 0.31 & 0.11 & 0.33 \\
    \midrule
